title: 208Y/120 V three-phase utility service, 150 kVA transformer

sources.citation: A three-phase pad-mounted distribution transformer for a small commercial building: 150 kVA, with an impedance of about 2–5 % and an X/R ratio of about 2–4, typical of published manufacturers' data for the size (paraphrased, not one vendor's). 4 % and an X/R of 3 are taken: per phase 0.04 × (√3 × 120)² / 150 000 = 11.5 mΩ, about 10.4 kA of bolted three-phase fault current.

120 V from each phase to the neutral of the 208Y/120 V three-phase four-wire nominal system of ANSI C84.1-2020 (the region profile's commercial system); 208 V is the rounded name of 120 × √3 = 207.85 V.
game-design: a placeholder size and terminal layout. Three-phase service is headless in P2 (gameplay is P6), so it is not drawn.
